GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (29 Jul 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1090)
APO 500
29 July 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum for IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT, file AG 000.5 (22 Jul 46) LS-R, (SCAPIN - 1075), dated 22 July 1946, subject: "Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals", is amended to read, insofar as TANAKA, Katsumi is concerned, as follows:
The following named Japanese will be apprehended, as a Suspected War Criminal, and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), as soon as his physical condition permits, Pending removal to Sugamo Prison, he will be detained in house arrest.
TANAKA, Katsumi Civilian Surgeon, Kyushu Imperial University Hospital - 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
